scope: Local pre-release browser budgets for representative non-Borg, non-Braid public webapps. Hosting transfer and EOM throughput remain separate domains.

instrument.invocation: Start scripts/dev/start-local-dev.mjs on a fresh loopback port per profile, open scripts/dev/browser-performance-probe.html with the declared route and viewport, and preserve the aggregate result before reusing that origin.
instrument.failureBehavior: Any missing measurement, changed source identity, unavailable required API, or exceeded budget fails the checker. Re-measure changed app or instrument sources; do not copy the former receipt forward.

gpu.surfaceProxyMethod: canvas backing-store lower bound; excludes textures, geometry, driver allocation, compositor copies, and shared GPU-process memory
gpu.processMethod: macOS ps RSS samples of the identified Codex GPU process before and during the foreground 4K profile
gpu.claimBoundary: The surface proxy is a per-page lower bound. GPU-process RSS is a measured shared-process envelope. Neither is exact per-page physical GPU memory.

budgets.resourceCountRationale: Operator decision, 2026-09-06: the indicative measured resource count is 17; a ceiling of 20 follows the same headroom logic as the byte ceiling for the intended shared control strip and three public manifests.
